transcript: Speaker A: मैं आम हूँ, किंग ऑफ़ फ्रूट्स। पूरी दुनिया मुझे जानती है। [I am mango, the king of fruits. The whole world knows me.] I am sweet, I am juicy, and I come only in summers, that makes me special. पर तुम मुझे खा लेते हो, डिस्क्राइब नहीं कर पाते। [But you eat me, and cannot describe me.] कोई पूछे, 'What does it taste like?', तुम बोलते हो, 'बहुत अच्छा है।' [If someone asks, 'What does it taste like?', you say, 'It is very good.'] बस, इतना ही? [Just that?] Taste like sunshine mixed with honey. My texture is smooth and buttery. मुझे अलफोंसो बोलो या हापुस, I am India's pride. [Call me Alphonso or Hapus, I am India's pride.] पर तुम ये इंग्लिश में नहीं बोल पाते, क्योंकि इंग्लिश में बोलना सीखा ही नहीं। [But you cannot say this in English, because you never learned to speak in English.] तो सुनो, मैं आम हूँ, मैं तो खुद नहीं सिखाऊंगा। [So listen, I am a mango, I won't teach you myself.] इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप सिखा सकती है। [The English Seekho app can teach you.] एक्सपर्ट के छोटे-छोटे वीडियोस हैं, हिंदी में समझा के इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाती हैं। [There are short videos by experts that explain in Hindi and teach you how to speak English.] एआई कोच है, उससे प्रैक्टिस करो। [There is an AI coach, practice with it.] गलत बोलो तो सुधार देगी, कभी जज नहीं करेगी। [If you speak incorrectly, it will correct you and never judge you.] I am just a mango, I'll be gone after summer. पर इंग्लिश सीख लो, तो वो लाइफटाइम रहेगी। [But if you learn English, it will stay with you for a lifetime.] इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Download the English Seekho app.] ट्रायल सिर्फ ₹1 का। [Trial for just 1 rupee.] स्टार्ट टुडे, बिकॉज़ इवन अ मैंगो नोज़ कि कल का भरोसा नहीं। [Start today, because even a mango knows that tomorrow is uncertain.] तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, English Seekho kisi bhi government authority institution brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai. [English Seekho is not endorsed, sponsored, affiliated, or associated with any government authority, institution brand, organisation, or individual.]
summary: An animated mango character points out that while people love eating mangoes, they cannot describe their taste in English. It promotes the English Seekho app to learn English through short videos and an AI coach, offering a trial for 1 rupee.
